crossRefs.note: “You shall take the breast of Aaron’s ram of consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before Yahweh. It shall be…
The priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.

parallels.note: You shall sanctify the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the wave offering, which is waved, and which is…
Aaron waved the breasts and the right thigh for a wave offering before Yahweh, as Moses commanded.
The waved breast and the heaved thigh you shall eat in a clean place, you, and your sons, and your daughters with you…
The heaved thigh and the waved breast they shall bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a…

translations.web: Their meat shall be yours, as the wave offering breast and as the right thigh, it shall be yours.
translations.bsb: And their meat belongs to you, just as the breast and right thigh of the wave offering belong to you.
translations.kjv: And the flesh of them shall be thine, as the wave breast and as the right shoulder
translations.asv: And the flesh of them shall be thine, as the wave-breast and as the right thigh, it shall be thine.
